manifest.role: post-freeze diagnostic; existing outcome-selected exercises, not an unbiased deployment sample

summary.averaging: equal coordinate weights; related coordinates share a source deal

manifest.cohort_generator: disjoint 1000-seed ranges, first root satisfying only public filter
cost_arms: PI-upper minus current actor continuation lower
priced-upper minus same actor continuation lower
manifest.grammar: fixed native standard Viewer library; no exact patches in learned actor
manifest.root_filter: unresolved contract, >=2 own legal actions, bounded mechanical support; no action-value filter
manifest.root_prior: exact uniform mechanical root fiber; no field likelihood before continuation initialization
manifest.selection: equal-root full-policy value on dev; ties fewer clauses then bytes then digest
